meta.name: standup
meta.description: Facilitate a read-only standup across git worktrees, branches, or PRs to compare changes and produce one consolidation plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 汇总多个分支或PR的变更，生成统一计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在多个工作分支间快速同步变更并制定合并计划
copy.tagline_en: Aggregate changes across branches or PRs into one consolidation plan
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly sync changes across multiple work branches and create a merge plan

howto.what: Claude 会把你的每个 git worktree、分支或 PR 当成独立 agent,拉进同一个 markdown 聊天室,分轮主持它们比对改动,最后给出一份合并计划:目标 worktree、合并顺序、冲突解法。全程只读。
howto.when: 当你要求比对多个 worktree、分支或 PR 的改动、整理成一份合并计划时触发;候选少于两个时它会说明这不构成 standup 并停下。

say.text: 用 standup 比一下这几个分支和开着的 PR,给我一个合并计划。
say.note: 先跑一轮各自介绍,再逐轮解决冲突。

say.text: 把 standup 的结论用大白话讲给我听,只列需要我拍板的事。
say.note: 它会转述成非技术描述并给出待决策项。

howto.what_en: Claude treats each git worktree, branch, or PR as its own agent in one shared markdown room, runs rounds to compare their changes, then writes a single consolidation plan (target worktree, merge order, conflict resolutions). Read-only.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to compare changes across multiple worktrees, branches, or PRs and pull them into one plan. With fewer than two candidates it stops and says this isn't a standup.

say_en.text: Run a standup on the worktrees with changes in the last 24 hours.
say_en.note: It lists candidates for you to confirm.

say_en.text: Compare these branches and my open PRs, then give me one merge plan.
say_en.note: Rounds of intros, then conflict resolution.

say_en.text: Explain the standup outcome in plain language and list only my decisions.
say_en.note: It translates the summation and asks for your calls.
